answer: Treat attestations as a trust graph and bound reward by its cut. Honest agents form one densely woven region; a sybil ring, however many masks it mints, still dangles from that region by only the few real vouchers it bought — its narrow set of attack edges. Make reward flow through those edges like water through a pipe: the protocol caps admitted reward per boundary edge, so minting a thousand fakes behind the same cut earns nothing extra. One honest voucher is the anchor; the ring is a raven mimicking a sonnet it never wrote, and the bottleneck exposes it.
